Added 2025 coverage: 14 curated papers spanning 3DGS-empowered VLA and manipulation, Gaussian world models, and feed-forward 3D reconstruction / visual geometry.
Expanded 2025 to 55 papers, added 28 papers for 2026, and added 11 benchmark rows including a new Waymo novel-trajectory FID track and LangSplatV2 LERF results.
